Neuroepithelial cell to radial glia transition: discover regulator genes and modules

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(ArchR)
addArchRGenome("hg38")
options(future.globals.maxSize = 20 * 1024^4)

library(ggplot2)
library(stringi)
library(tidyr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(GOSemSim)
library(enrichplot)
library(patchwork)
library(scales) # for "squish", which displays infinite number inside the axis range
library(Seurat)
library(WGCNA)
library(hdWGCNA)
library(harmony)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
```



# 1. RG Seurat
## (1) ArchR_RG
```{r}
load("./data_rda/Script3/ArchR_EHB_5ct.rda")
ArchR_EHB_RG <- ArchR_EHB_5ct[ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0=="Radial glia",]
ArchR_EHB_RG # 22,311 RG cells
ArchR_EHB_RG$Stage <- stri_replace_all_regex(ArchR_EHB_RG$Age, pattern = c("CS14","CS16","CS17","CS20","CS21"), 
                                             replacement = c("Early","Early","Late","Late","Late"), vectorise_all = FALSE)
save(ArchR_EHB_RG, file = "./data_rda/Script5/ArchR_EHB_RG.rda")
rm(ArchR_EHB_5ct)
gc()
```

## (2) Seurat
```{r}
# get gene scores ~ 1 min
load("./data_rda/Script5/ArchR_EHB_RG.rda")
gene_score_matrix <- getMatrixFromProject(ArchR_EHB_RG, useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix")

# create Seurat object
gene_scores <- assay(gene_score_matrix)
gene_scores <- as.matrix(gene_scores)
rownames(gene_scores) <- gene_score_matrix@elementMetadata@listData[["name"]]
seurat_RG <- CreateSeuratObject(data = gene_scores, assay = "ATAC")

# add metadata
seurat_RG <- AddMetaData(seurat_RG, metadata = as.data.frame(colData(gene_score_matrix)))
rm(gene_score_matrix, gene_scores)
gc()

# scale data
## no need to run NormalizeData(), keep gene score - already normalised
## no need to run FindVariableFeatures(), because top variable genes are too noisy (non-coding RNA) -> uses all genes for scaling and downstream
seurat_RG <- ScaleData(seurat_RG)  # gene-wise z-scoring
seurat_RG # 24961 genes, 22311 cells, scale.data contains all genes
```

```{r}
set.seed(100)

# PCA
seurat_RG <- RunPCA(seurat_RG, features = rownames(seurat_RG))

# true dimensionality = 10
ElbowPlot(seurat_RG, ndims = 50)

# batch correction for sequencing chemistry ~ 20s
seurat_RG@meta.data[["batch"]] <- "scATAC"
seurat_RG@meta.data[["batch"]][seurat_RG@meta.data[["ID"]] == "FB-16"] <- "multiome"
seurat_RG <- RunHarmony(seurat_RG, group.by.vars = "batch")

# UMAP ~ 15s
seurat_RG <- RunUMAP(seurat_RG, dims = 1:30, reduction = "harmony")
```

## (3) ctAnnot
### clustering
```{r}
# find clusters
set.seed(100)
seurat_RG <- FindNeighbors(seurat_RG, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:10)
seurat_RG <- FindClusters(seurat_RG, resolution = 0.8, cluster.name = "clusters_0.8")
seurat_RG <- FindClusters(seurat_RG, resolution = 1, cluster.name = "clusters_1.0")
seurat_RG <- FindClusters(seurat_RG, resolution = 1.2, cluster.name = "clusters_1.2")
seurat_RG <- FindClusters(seurat_RG, resolution = 1.5, cluster.name = "clusters_1.5")
```

```{r}
# clustree: select the best resolution
library(clustree)
clustree_df <- cbind("1", seurat_RG$clusters_0.8, seurat_RG$clusters_1.0, seurat_RG$clusters_1.2, seurat_RG$clusters_1.5)
colnames(clustree_df) <- paste0("resolution", c(0, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, 1.5))
clustree(clustree_df, prefix = "resolution") +
  guides(edge_colour = "none", edge_alpha = "none", size = "none") +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 14), legend.title = element_text(size = 16), legend.position = "right")
rm(clustree_df)
```

```{r}
# UMAP
DimPlot(seurat_RG, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, group.by = c("clusters_1.2"), shuffle = TRUE, raster = FALSE) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) + guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 3, override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  theme(axis.line = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank())
```

### markers
```{r}
# nCell per cluster, downsample to 500
table(seurat_RG$clusters_1.2)

# cluster maker genes ~ 20 min (1 min per cluster)
Idents(seurat_RG) <- seurat_RG$clusters_1.2
cluster_markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat_RG) # use raw gene score
save(cluster_markers, file = "./data_rda/Script5/cluster_markers.rda")
```

```{r}
# ct markers
## - tNE: ZEB2, LMNB1/2, SOX2, PAX6
## - vRG (and NE): HES1
## - oRG (apical RG): HOPX, NFIX, PROM1
## - truncated RG: CRYAB
ctMarkers <- c("HOPX","CRYAB","ZEB2","SOX2","PAX6","LMNB1","LMNB2","HES1","NFIX","PROM1")
```

```{r}
# top cluster markers
cluster_markers_fil <- cluster_markers[cluster_markers$avg_log2FC >= log2(1.5),]
cluster_markers_fil <- cluster_markers[cluster_markers$p_val_adj <= 0.01,]
cluster_markers_top <- cluster_markers_fil %>% arrange(p_val_adj) %>% group_by(cluster)  %>% slice(1:5)

# RG subtype markers, ordered by logFC
cluster_markers_st <- cluster_markers[cluster_markers$gene %in% ctMarkers,]
cluster_markers_st <- cluster_markers_st[order(cluster_markers_st$p_val_adj),]
cluster_markers_st <- cluster_markers_st[cluster_markers_st$p_val_adj <= 0.01,]
cluster_markers_st <- cluster_markers_st[cluster_markers_st$avg_log2FC  >= log2(1.5),]

# cluster marker table
cluster_info <- data.frame()
for (x in unique(cluster_markers$cluster)){
  # regional info
  regions <- seurat_RG$Region[seurat_RG$clusters_1.2 == x]
  cluster_info <- rbind(cluster_info, 
                        c(x, sum(seurat_RG$clusters_1.2 == x), # cell count
                        round(mean(as.numeric(sub("CS","",seurat_RG$Age[seurat_RG$clusters_1.2 == x]))),2), # avg age
                        paste0(names(which.max(table(regions))), " (", round(max(table(regions)) / length(regions),3), ")"), # region
                        paste(cluster_markers_top$gene[cluster_markers_top$cluster == x], collapse = " | "), # top cluster markers
                        paste(cluster_markers_st$gene[cluster_markers_st$cluster == x], collapse = " | ") # cell type markers
                        )) 
  rm(x, regions)
}
names(cluster_info) <- c("cluster","cell count","mean age","main region (proportion)","top cluster markers","RG subtype markers")
```

### add annotation
```{r}
# import annotation
ctAnnot <- readxl::read_excel("./data_output/Script5_ctAnnotation/ctAnnot_ATAC_RG.xlsx", sheet = 1)
ctAnnot <- ctAnnot[,c("Cluster","Subtype")]
ctAnnot$Cluster <- paste0("C",ctAnnot$Cluster)

# add cell type annotations
seurat_RG$fix <- paste0("C",seurat_RG$clusters_1.2)
seurat_RG$ctAnnot_RG <- stri_replace_all_regex(seurat_RG$fix,
                              pattern = ctAnnot$Cluster[!ctAnnot$Cluster %in% c("C1")], 
                              replacement = ctAnnot$Subtype[!ctAnnot$Cluster %in% c("C1")],
                              vectorize = FALSE)
seurat_RG$ctAnnot_RG <- stri_replace_all_regex(seurat_RG$ctAnnot_RG, 
                              pattern = ctAnnot$Cluster, 
                              replacement = ctAnnot$Subtype,
                              vectorize = FALSE)
seurat_RG$ctAnnot_RG <- factor(seurat_RG$ctAnnot_RG, levels = c("tRG","oRG","vRG","tNE"))
rm(ctAnnot)
```

## (4) sanity check
### main fig - ct trend
```{r}
# ct trend plot
annot_summary <- data.frame()
for (x in unique(seurat_RG$Age)){
  for (y in unique(seurat_RG$Region)){
    for (z in unique(seurat_RG$ctAnnot_RG)){
      n <- sum(seurat_RG$Age==x & seurat_RG$Region==y & seurat_RG$ctAnnot_RG==z)
      p <- n/sum(seurat_RG$Age==x & seurat_RG$Region==y)
      annot_summary <- rbind(annot_summary, c(x,y,z,n,p))
    }
  }
  rm(x,y,z,n,p)
}
names(annot_summary) <- c("Age", "Region", "Subtype", "nCell", "Proportion")
annot_summary$nCell <- as.numeric(annot_summary$nCell)
annot_summary$Proportion <- as.numeric(annot_summary$Proportion)
annot_summary$Region <- factor(annot_summary$Region, levels=c("Forebrain","CerebellumPons","Medulla"))
annot_summary$Subtype <- factor(annot_summary$Subtype, levels = c("tRG","oRG", "vRG","tNE"))
annot_summary$Age <- as.numeric(sub("CS","",annot_summary$Age))
```

# 2. Trajectory
```{r}
load("./data_rda/Script5/ArchR_EHB_RG.rda")
addArchRThreads(8)
set.seed(100)
```

## (1) preparation
```{r}
# ArchR add ct
ctAnnot <- seurat_RG_processed$ctAnnot_RG
ctAnnot <- ctAnnot[getCellNames(ArchR_EHB_RG)]
sum(names(ctAnnot) == getCellNames(ArchR_EHB_RG)) == length(ctAnnot)
ArchR_EHB_RG$ctAnnot_RG <- ctAnnot

# ArchR add harmony-corrected PCA space
reduction_harmony <- seurat_RG_processed@reductions[["harmony"]]@cell.embeddings
reduction_harmony <- reduction_harmony[getCellNames(ArchR_EHB_RG),]
sum(row.names(reduction_harmony) == getCellNames(ArchR_EHB_RG)) == nrow(reduction_harmony)
ArchR_EHB_RG@reducedDims$Harmony_RG <- ArchR_EHB_RG@reducedDims$Harmony_age
ArchR_EHB_RG@reducedDims$Harmony_RG$matDR <- reduction_harmony
ArchR_EHB_RG@reducedDims$Harmony_RG$params <- NULL
ArchR_EHB_RG@reducedDims$Harmony_RG$date <- Sys.time()

# ArchR add UMAP
umap <- seurat_RG_processed@reductions[["umap"]]@cell.embeddings
umap <- as.data.frame(umap[getCellNames(ArchR_EHB_RG),])
ArchR_EHB_RG <- addUMAP(ArchR_EHB_RG, reducedDims = "Harmony_RG", name = "UMAP_RG", force = TRUE)
ArchR_EHB_RG@embeddings@listData[["UMAP_RG"]]@listData[["df"]] <- umap
names(ArchR_EHB_RG@embeddings@listData[["UMAP_RG"]]@listData[["df"]]) <- c("Harmony_RG#UMAP_Dimension_1","Harmony_RG#UMAP_Dimension_2")
plotEmbedding(ArchR_EHB_RG, colorBy = "cellColData", name = "ctAnnot_RG", embedding = "UMAP_RG",  labelMeans=FALSE,
              pal = c(tNE="#463C91",vRG="#5E4CE6",oRG="#9E8FFF",tRG="#BFB6FA"))

rm(ctAnnot, reduction_harmony, umap)
gc()
```

```{r}
# region-specific UMAP
ArchR_lineage_RG <- list()
for (x in unique(ArchR_EHB_RG$Region)){
  print(x)
  ArchR_lineage_RG[[x]] <- ArchR_EHB_RG[ArchR_EHB_RG$Region == x,]
  ArchR_lineage_RG[[x]]@projectMetadata@listData[["outputDirectory"]] <- "./ArchR_lineage/RG"
  
  # add UMAP
  ArchR_lineage_RG[[x]] <- addUMAP(ArchR_lineage_RG[[x]], reducedDims = "Harmony_RG",name = "UMAP_RG_rg", 
                                   nNeighbors = 30, minDist = 1, metric = "cosine", force = TRUE)
  
  # save UMAP plots
  plotPDF(plotEmbedding(ArchR_lineage_RG[[x]], colorBy = "cellColData", name = "Age", embedding = "UMAP_RG_rg",  labelMeans=FALSE,
                        pal = c(CS14="#704D9E", CS16="#BC5AA9", CS17="#ED7C97", CS20="#f79452", CS21="#f2de5c")),
          name = paste0("RG_UMAP_",x,"_Age.pdf"), ArchRProj = ArchR_lineage_RG[[x]], addDOC = FALSE, width = 6, height = 6)
  plotPDF(plotEmbedding(ArchR_lineage_RG[[x]], colorBy = "cellColData", name = "ctAnnot_RG", embedding = "UMAP_RG_rg",  labelMeans=FALSE,
                        pal = c(tNE="#463C91",vRG="#5E4CE6",oRG="#9E8FFF",tRG="#BFB6FA")), 
          name = paste0("RG_UMAP_",x,"_ct.pdf"), ArchRProj = ArchR_lineage_RG[[x]], addDOC = FALSE, width = 6, height = 6)
  rm(x)
}
```


## (2) trajectory
```{r}
# compute trajectory: tNE → vRG → oRG
p <- list()
for (x in names(ArchR_lineage_RG)){
  # add a trajectory for the given stage on the shared UMAP
  ArchR_lineage_RG[[x]] <- addTrajectory(ArchRProj = ArchR_lineage_RG[[x]], name = x, groupBy = "ctAnnot_RG", reducedDims = "Harmony_RG",
                               trajectory = c("tNE","vRG","oRG"), embedding = "UMAP_RG_rg",
                               preFilterQuantile = 0.95, postFilterQuantile = 0.95, force = TRUE, spar = 1.5)
  plot <- plotTrajectory(ArchR_lineage_RG[[x]], embedding = "UMAP_RG_rg", trajectory = x, colorBy = "cellColData", name = x,
                         plotAs = "points", continuousSet = "solarExtra")
  p[[x]] <- plot[[1]]
  rm(x)
}

# saving PDF
pdf("./ArchR_lineage/RG/Plots/RG_trajectory.pdf", width = 3, height = 3.6)
p
dev.off()
```


## ----- save ArchR -----
```{r}
save(ArchR_lineage_RG, file = "./data_rda/Script5/ArchR_lineage_RG.rda")
```



# 3. hdWGCNA - ATAC
Gene co-accessibility networks
GitHub for R package: https://github.com/smorabit/hdWGCNA/tree/dev
Tutorials list: https://smorabit.github.io/hdWGCNA/articles/hdWGCNA.html
Key tutorials I followed in this script:
  - hdWGCNA in single-cell data: https://smorabit.github.io/hdWGCNA/articles/basic_tutorial.html
  - Network Visualization: https://smorabit.github.io/hdWGCNA/articles/network_visualizations.html
Project RNA-seq to ATAC-seq: 
  - hdWGCNA tutorial: https://smorabit.github.io/hdWGCNA/articles/projecting_modules_cross.html
  - hdWGCNA paper: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10326379/?utm_source=chatgpt.com

## (1) hdWGCNA
### run WGCNA
```{r}
# use genes that are detected in more than 70% cells ~ 35s
seurat_RG <- SetupForWGCNA(seurat_RG, wgcna_name = "RG_gene_networks", gene_select = "fraction",  fraction = 0.70)
"ZEB2" %in% seurat_RG@misc[["RG_gene_networks"]][["wgcna_genes"]]
length(seurat_RG@misc[["RG_gene_networks"]][["wgcna_genes"]]) # 5116 genes

# construct metacells for Age × Region, and grouping by age to give more robust correlations ~ 3 min
seurat_RG <- MetacellsByGroups(seurat_RG, group.by = c("Age","Region"), ident.group = 'Age', reduction = 'pca', k = 25)

# normalize metacell expression matrix
seurat_RG <- NormalizeMetacells(seurat_RG)

# set up the co-expression matrix
seurat_RG <- SetDatExpr(seurat_RG, group.by='Age', group_name = c("CS14","CS16","CS17","CS20","CS21"), assay = 'ATAC')
```

```{r}
# test different soft powers
seurat_RG <- TestSoftPowers(seurat_RG, networkType = 'unsigned')
p <- PlotSoftPowers(seurat_RG)
patchwork::wrap_plots(p, ncol=2)                                 
rm(p)

# construct co-expression network ~ 3.5 min
seurat_RG <- ConstructNetwork(seurat_RG, tom_name = 'RG_gene_networks_', soft_power = 5, minModuleSize = 10,
                              tom_outdir = "data_rda/Script5", overwrite_tom = TRUE)
```

```{r}
seurat_RG@misc[["RG_gene_networks"]][["wgcna_modules"]][["color"]] <-

                         pattern = c("white","lightyellow","lightcyan"), replacement = c("pink2","lightyellow3","darkcyan"),
                         vectorize_all = FALSE)
seurat_RG@misc[["RG_gene_networks"]][["wgcna_modules"]][["module"]] <-

                         pattern = c("white","lightyellow","lightcyan"), replacement = c("pink2","lightyellow3","darkcyan"),
                         vectorize_all = FALSE)
seurat_RG@misc[["RG_gene_networks"]][["wgcna_modules"]][["module"]] <-

         levels = unique(seurat_RG@misc[["RG_gene_networks"]][["wgcna_modules"]][["module"]]))
```

### compute connectivity
```{r}
# compute all MEs for single cells ~ 3 min
seurat_RG <- ModuleEigengenes(seurat_RG)

seurat_RG <- ModuleConnectivity(seurat_RG,  group.by='Age', group_name = c("CS14","CS16","CS17","CS20","CS21"))
```

## (2) differential accessibility
```{r}
# get colour ref
modules <- GetModules(seurat_RG_processed) %>% subset(module != 'grey')
colour_ref <- unique(modules[,2:3])
row.names(colour_ref) <- NULL
colour_ref$module <- sub("_","-",colour_ref$module)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# differential accessible MODULES, split region
p <- list()
summary <- list()
for (y in c("CS16_CS14", "CS17_CS16")){
  summary[[y]] <- list()
  for (x in unique(seurat_RG_processed@meta.data$Region)){
    DME <- FindDMEs(seurat_RG_processed, test.use='wilcox',
                    barcodes1 = seurat_RG_processed@meta.data %>% subset(Age==sub("_.*","",y) & Region==x) %>% rownames,
                    barcodes2 = seurat_RG_processed@meta.data %>% subset(Age==sub(".*_","",y) & Region==x) %>% rownames)
    DME <- DME[order(DME$avg_log2FC),]
    DME$colour <- colour_ref$color[order(match(colour_ref$module, DME$module))]
    DME$module <- sub("Module-","M",DME$module)
    DME$module <- factor(DME$module, levels = DME$module)
    DME$result <- "non-significant"
    DME$result[DME$p_val_adj < 0.01 & DME$avg_log2FC >= 2] <- "hyper-accessible"
    DME$result[DME$p_val_adj < 0.01 & DME$avg_log2FC <= -2] <- "hypo-accessible"
    summary[[y]][[x]] <- DME
    
    x <- stri_replace_all_regex(x, pattern = c("Forebrain","Medulla","CerebellumPons"), 
                                replacement = c("FB","MD","CP"), vectorize_all = FALSE)
    p[[paste0(x,"_",y)]] <- ggplot(DME, aes(y=module, x=avg_log2FC, color=module, shape = result)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept=0, color='black') + 
      geom_segment(aes(y=module, yend=module, x=0, xend=avg_log2FC), linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.3) +
      geom_point(size=3) + # guides(shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5)), color = "none", size = "none") +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c("hyper-accessible"=19, "hypo-accessible"=17, "non-significant"=13)) +
      scale_color_manual(values=DME$colour[])  + scale_x_continuous(oob = squish) + BuenColors::pretty_plot() +
      ylab('') + xlab(bquote("Avg. log"[2]~"(Fold Change)")) + labs(shape = "") +
      ggtitle(paste0(sub("_.*","",y), " vs ", sub(".*_","",y)," in ", x)) +
      theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), 
            axis.text.y = element_text(size=11), axis.text.x = element_text(size=11),
            legend.position = "none", legend.text = element_text(size = 14))
  }
  rm(x, y, DME)
}
```

## (3) selected modules
### module member genes
```{r}
# get gene locations
load("./data_rda/Script5/ArchR_EHB_RG.rda")
gene_location <- ArchR_EHB_RG@geneAnnotation@listData[["genes"]]

# assign genes into location groups (genes that are within 1000kb of each other are grouped together)
module_genes <- list()
for (x in unique(modules$module)){
  module_genes[[x]] <- as.data.frame(gene_location[gene_location$symbol %in% modules[modules$module==x,]$gene_name])
  module_genes[[x]]$group <- 1
  for (i in 2:nrow(module_genes[[x]])) {
    if (module_genes[[x]]$seqnames[i] == module_genes[[x]]$seqnames[i - 1]) {
      distance <- module_genes[[x]]$start[i] - module_genes[[x]]$end[i - 1]
      if (distance > 1000000) {
        module_genes[[x]]$group[i] <- module_genes[[x]]$group[i - 1] + 1
      } else {
        module_genes[[x]]$group[i] <- module_genes[[x]]$group[i - 1]
      }
    } else {
      module_genes[[x]]$group[i] <- module_genes[[x]]$group[i - 1] + 1
    }
  }  
  rm(x, i, distance)  
}
rm(gene_location)
```

```{r}

# get gene membership (kME)

  module_genes[[x]]$kME <- module_fil[,paste0("kME_",x)]

  rm(x, module_fil)
}
```

### main fig - circular plot
```{r}
# genes in selected modules of interest
module_genes_top <- list()
for (x in select){
  print(nrow(module_genes[[x]]))
  module_genes_top[[x]] <- na.omit(module_genes[[x]][1:30,])
  rm(x)
}

# modules of interest
for (x in select){
  # add 'empty bar' at the end of each group
  data <- module_genes_top[[x]][,c("symbol","group","kME")]
  to_add <- data.frame(matrix(NA, length(unique(data$group)), ncol(data)))
  colnames(to_add) <- colnames(data)
  to_add$group <- rep(unique(data$group), each=1)
  data <- rbind(data, to_add)
  data <- data %>% arrange(group)
  data$id <- seq(1, nrow(data))
  
  # Get the name and the y position of each label
  label_data <- data
  number_of_bar <- nrow(label_data)
  angle <- 90 - 360 * (label_data$id-0.5) /number_of_bar
  label_data$hjust <- ifelse( angle < -90, 1, 0)
  label_data$angle <- ifelse(angle < -90, angle+180, angle)
   
  # Make the plot
  png(paste0("./ArchR_EHB/Plots/Script5/WGCNA/circle_selected_",x,".png"), width = 1500, height = 1500, res = 800)
  print(ggplot(data, aes(x=as.factor(id), y=kME, fill=as.factor(group))) +
          geom_bar(stat="identity", alpha=0.8) + 
          ylim(-0.2,1) + theme_minimal() + coord_polar() + 
          theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0, face = "bold"), legend.position = "none", 
          axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank()) +
          geom_text(data=label_data, aes(x=id, y=kME+0.08, label=symbol, hjust=hjust), 
              alpha=0.6, size=1.5, angle=label_data$angle, inherit.aes=FALSE) +
      annotate("text", x = 0, y = -0.2, label = sub("Module_","M",x), size = 3, fontface = "bold", 
               color = colour_ref$color[colour_ref$module==sub("_","-",x)]))
  dev.off()
  
  rm(x, data, to_add, label_data, number_of_bar, angle)
}

rm(module_genes_top)
```

### main fig - accessibility pseudotime
```{r}
load("./data_rda/Script5/ArchR_lineage_RG.rda")
```

```{r}
hME_summary <- list()
subtype <- list()
for (x in names(ArchR_lineage_RG)){
  # pseudotime bins
  pseudotime <- data.frame(cellID = getCellNames(ArchR_lineage_RG[[x]]), 
                           pseudotime = ArchR_lineage_RG[[x]]@cellColData@listData[[x]],
                           celltype = ArchR_lineage_RG[[x]]$ctAnnot_RG)
  pseudotime <- pseudotime[!is.na(pseudotime$pseudotime),]
  pseudotime$bin <- pmin(floor(pseudotime$pseudotime) + 1, 100)
  
  hME_summary[[x]] <- data.frame()
  subtype[[x]] <- data.frame()
  for(y in 1:100){
    # avg cell type for each pseudotime bin 
    subtype[[x]] <- rbind(subtype[[x]], c(bin=y, celltype=names(which.max(table(pseudotime$celltype[pseudotime$bin==y])))))
    
    # avg hMEs for each pseudotime bin
    hME <- seurat_RG_processed@misc$RG_gene_networks$hMEs[pseudotime[pseudotime$bin==y,]$cellID,] # harmonised MEs
    hME <- colMeans(hME[names(hME)!="grey"])
    hME_summary[[x]] <- rbind(hME_summary[[x]], c(bin=y,hME))
  }
  names(subtype[[x]]) <- c("bin","subtype")
  subtype[[x]]$bin <- as.numeric(subtype[[x]]$bin)
  names(hME_summary[[x]]) <- c("bin",names(hME))
  rm(x, y, pseudotime, hME)
}
```

```{r}
# plot: pseudotime bins
p0 <- list()
smooth <- 1
for (x in names(subtype)){
  # smooth across bins
  subtype_smooth <- subtype[[x]]
  subtype_smooth$subtype <- factor(subtype_smooth$subtype, levels = c("tNE","vRG","oRG"))
  for (bin in 1:100/smooth){
    subtype_smooth$subtype[subtype_smooth$bin >= bin*100/smooth-smooth+1 & subtype_smooth$bin <= bin*smooth] <- 
      names(which.max(table(subtype_smooth$subtype[subtype_smooth$bin >= bin*smooth-4 & subtype_smooth$bin <= bin*smooth])))
  }
  
  # plot
  p0[[x]] <- ggplot(subtype_smooth, aes(x=bin, y=0, fill=subtype)) + geom_tile() + 
    theme_void() + scale_fill_manual(values = c(tNE="#463C91",vRG="#5E4CE6",oRG="#9E8FFF")) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 8)
  rm(x, bin)
}
save(p0, file = "./data_rda/script5/p_pseudotime_bin.rda")
```
